main_idea: BAR is a large legal benchmark built to evaluate end-to-end agent work.
ideas: BAR covers 5,161 cases, 28 practice areas, and 11,075 documents.
BAR-informed harness changes improved output quality by 5%.
The benchmark uses realistic matters developed with law firms.
summary: The graphic is complete, but the separate quality result and repeated grid explanation distract from BAR's scale.
